name: orchestration
description: A pane that shows subagents and workflow agents as they run, their models and token counts, flags a review that ran on the same model as its work, and logs usage to a JSON lines file per session.

logLabels.title: Write agent labels to the usage log
logLabels.description: Off by default: the usage log, the totals store and the export then carry only an agent's seat, stage word and id. On: they also carry its description, which may hold private words.
